title: Soil-layer thickness files call layer numbers depths in metres
description: The static resource numbers its layers 1 to 6. Publication then labels those numbers as physical depth in metres, although the whole soil column is only 4.6 m deep.
example: Matching slthick to soil temperature by depth can pair the wrong layers or find no match at all. The thickness values are sensible; it is the coordinate describing where those values belong that is wrong.
scientific_evidence: All 138 fixed-file headers have the same false physical coordinate. The resource supplies dimensionless sdepth indices; publication relabels them as depth in metres. The sampled thickness data themselves are the correct [.022,.058,.154,.409,1.085,2.872] m.
impact: Joining or interpolating slthick with tsl or mrsol by physical depth silently mismatches layers. The raw thickness numbers can still be used by verified layer index.
recommended_action: Assign the shared native CABLE centres and bounds before publication. Check missing ocean values as well: the sampled resource-derived thickness also uses zero outside land. Preserve real layer thicknesses.
development_team_action: MOPPy: apply shared CABLE physical centres/bounds to the slthick resource and mask its all-zero ocean columns. Both supported models use this resource; the implementation covers both. Native model geometry is consistent, so no model-code change is indicated.
extent_statement: Complete file list within the identified release versions; numerical confirmation was sampled, not a scan of every value.
publication_action: No withdrawal, retraction, replacement or ESGF submission performed by this task.
validation: Fresh Gadi CMIP7 and CMIP6 slthick outputs preserve all 65,190 valid layer thicknesses, restore 16,975 ocean-column masks and align with fresh tsl/mrsol coordinates. All 277 focused tests passed.
